note: secondary analysis of already-accounted TRANSFORM/SUSTAIN studies.

title: Intranasal esketamine effectively treats treatment-resistant depression in adults regardless of baseline irritability.
quote: This was a post hoc analysis of pooled data from two 4-week, double-blind, phase 3 studies: TRANSFORM-1 (NCT02417064) and TRANSFORM-2 (NCT02418585).

title: Predictors of response and remission in patients with treatment-resistant depression: A post hoc pooled analysis of two acute trials of esketamine nasal spray.

title: Assessment of health-related quality of life and health status in patients with treatment-resistant depression treated with esketamine nasal spray plus an oral antidepressant.
quote: Data from TRANSFORM-2, a phase 3, randomized, double-blind, short-term flexibly dosed study, were analyzed.

title: Efficacy and safety of esketamine nasal spray by sex in patients with treatment-resistant depression: findings from short-term randomized, controlled trials.

note: post hoc sex subgroup analysis of already-accounted TRANSFORM trials.

title: Different symptomatic improvement pattern revealed by factor analysis between placebo response and response to Esketamine in treatment resistant depression.
quote: Using data from a randomized, double-blind (DB), placebo-controlled trial of esketamine (ESK) in patients with treatment-resistant depression (TRD), we conducted exploratory analyses.
